name: Oasis

whyMatters.en: Manchester Britpop band that restored loud, Beatles-citing guitar anthems to mid-90s UK charts against grunge’s US dominance.
whyMatters.zh: 曼彻斯特 Britpop：在 grunge 的美国主导下，把大声、引用 Beatles 的吉他颂歌送回 90 年代中期英国榜。

note.en: Mid-tempo UK counter to grunge gloom.
note.zh: 对位 grunge 阴郁的中速英国宣言。
Britpop 的全球原声—电声钩子。

interviewQuotes.text: We're the best band in the world.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Noel Gallagher

lyricQuotes: Maybe you're gonna be the one that saves me

shortBio.en: Gallagher brothers Britpop; Wonderwall and Live Forever are the mass poles.
shortBio.zh: Gallagher 兄弟的 Britpop；Wonderwall 与 Live Forever 是大众两极。

body.en:
Formed 1991. Definitely Maybe (1994) and (What’s the Story) Morning Glory? (1995) fix Noel’s songwriting, Liam’s sneering mid-range, loud guitars, and terrace-chant choruses.

Live Forever (1994) and Wonderwall / Don’t Look Back in Anger (1995) are the teaching set. Sibling feud and lineup churn are documented; the musical object is song craft plus volume.
body.zh:
1991 年组建。Definitely Maybe（1994）与 (What’s the Story) Morning Glory?（1995）定型 Noel 写作、Liam 冷笑中音区、大声吉他与看台口号副歌。

Live Forever（1994）与 Wonderwall / Don’t Look Back in Anger（1995）是教材组。兄弟争执与阵容更替有文献；音乐对象是歌曲工艺加音量。

title.en: Britain turns guitar volume back up
title.zh: 英国把吉他音量拧回去

body.en:
Oasis matter as a chart and attitude reset: open chords, loud mixes, northern vocal, Beatles/Stone Roses citations against mid-90s US grunge radio.

Britpop’s stadium pole, not its art-school pole.
body.zh:
Oasis 要紧处是榜单与态度重置：开放和弦、大声混音、北方人声、Beatles/Stone Roses 引用，对位 90 年代中期美国 grunge 电台。

Britpop 的体育场一极，而非艺术学院一极。

body.en:
Noel/Liam are the constant engine; guitarists and drummers change across peaks and later years.

Classic Britpop peak version vs later name-continuation versions.
body.zh:
Noel/Liam 是恒定引擎；吉他手与鼓手在巅峰与后期更替。

经典 Britpop 巅峰版本 vs 后期名称延续版本。

body.en:
Definitely Maybe–era statement track—melody forward, guitars wide, lyric defiance without metal gloom.

UK answer to imported alternative sadness, in song form.
body.zh:
Definitely Maybe 时期声明曲——旋律靠前、吉他宽、歌词反抗而无金属阴郁。

以歌曲形式回答进口 alternative 伤感。

body.en:
Strummed figure, Liam’s vocal, singalong chorus—exportable beyond UK Britpop wars.

Earworm with attitude; arrangement stays simple on purpose.
body.zh:
扫弦音型、Liam 人声、合唱副歌——可导出到英国 Britpop 论战之外。

带态度的耳虫；编曲故意保持简单。

title.zh: Beatles 幽灵，Stone Roses 步态

body.en:
Chord moves and vocal phrasing cite 1960s UK pop; swagger and baggy residue cite Madchester. Not a cover band—a citation engine at terrace volume.

Influence shows in 2000s UK indie anthems.
body.zh:
和弦进行与人声句式引用 1960 年代英国流行；姿态与 baggy 残余引用 Madchester。不是翻唱乐队——是看台音量的引用引擎。

影响见于 2000 年代英国 indie 颂歌。

body.en:
Press feuds with Blur and between brothers are part of the public record. Useful as scene sociology; musical judgment still returns to the singles.

Attitude is documented speech, not metaphor.
body.zh:
与 Blur 及兄弟间的媒体争执属公开记录。可作场景社会学；音乐判断仍回到单曲。

态度是被记录的话语，不是比喻。

note.en: Sibling engine at peak before later fractures.
note.zh: 后期分裂前的兄弟引擎巅峰。

note.en: Name continues; cast and chemistry shift.
note.zh: 名称延续；人马与化学作用改变。
Definitely Maybe 早期自信单曲。

note.en: Beatles-citing craft + terrace volume on mid-90s charts.
note.zh: 引用 Beatles 的工艺 + 看台音量占据 90 年代中期榜单。
